samples.summary: The new prototype-key guard is applied in one controller only; ~10 sibling v1 controllers do the identical `root.sheets?.[tabId]` lookup-then-write and are left unguarded
samples.evidence: The delta adds `UNSAFE_TAB_IDS` / `assertPlainTabId` as a private helper inside `worksheet-images.controller.ts` and calls it from `worksheetOrThrow` and `getImages`. Its own docblock argues the hazard is generic: "`:tabId` reaches this controller straight off the URL … On a plain object … `sheets['__proto__']` answers `Object.prototype`: truthy, so the NotFound guard passes". That reasoning applies verbatim to every other v1 worksheet controller, none of which was changed: `worksheet.controller.ts:46-50` (`worksheetOrThrow`, then `ws.frozenRows = …`), `worksheet-rules.controller.ts:59`, `worksheet-styles.controller.ts:54`, `worksheet-charts.controller.ts:49`, `worksheet-dimensions.controller.ts:57` (and its six `doc.getRoot().sheets?.[tabId]` writers), `worksheet-filter-pivot.controller.ts:47`, `cells.controller.ts:88/125/158/193/230`, `comments.controller.ts:237/323/559/730`, and `tabs.controller.ts:251` (`if (!root.tabs?.[tabId]) …` immediately before `duplicateTab` writes `root.sheets[newTabId]`). Fixing one of eleven identical call sites places the check at the wrong layer (per-controller private function rather than the shared worksheet-lookup helper the rest of the surface uses) and leaves the stated defect reachable through the other ten routes.
searchedFor: read worksheet.controller.ts, worksheet-structure.controller.ts, tabs.controller.ts worksheetOrThrow implementations

samples.summary: A hardcoded key denylist reinvents the existing `safeWorksheetRecordKeys` tab-existence check, giving two divergent answers to "is this a real tab?"
samples.evidence: `ApiV1WorksheetStructureController.worksheetOrThrow` (worksheet-structure.controller.ts:104-113) already solves exactly this lookup: `if (!sheets || !safeWorksheetRecordKeys(sheets).includes(tabId)) throw new NotFoundException('Tab not found')`. That helper is exported from `@wafflebase/sheets` (`packages/sheets/src/model/workbook/worksheet-record.ts:33`, re-exported at `src/index.ts:169`), works on both a Yorkie proxy (`ownKeys` trap) and a plain object, tolerates duplicate CRDT keys, and rejects `__proto__`/`constructor`/`prototype` inherently because they are never in the key list. The new `UNSAFE_TAB_IDS` denylist is a third, narrower mechanism whose docblock explicitly dismisses own-property tests without mentioning the key-list approach the repo already ships; the two checks can now drift (e.g. a future inherited key that is not in the three-item list).
searchedFor: grep `__proto__` repo-wide for an existing shared guard

samples.summary: New user-visible duplicate-tab semantics (charts repointed, pivot definition and `kind` dropped) are recorded only in a code comment; no design doc covers the tab-duplicate endpoint at all
samples.evidence: `duplicateTab` now defines product rules — a self-sourced chart is repointed at the copy, a foreign-sourced one is not, and a pivot output tab duplicates as a plain snapshot losing `pivotTable` and `TabMeta.kind`. `docs/design/rest-api.md` §5.2 still lists only `GET`/`POST` tabs and `PATCH .../tabs/:tid` (lines 197-210) — the `POST :tabId/duplicate` route (tabs.controller.ts:238) and these copy rules appear nowhere; `docs/design/sheets/charts.md` and `docs/design/sheets/pivot-table.md` say nothing about duplication (pivot-table.md only states `kind` and `pivotTable` are "set together and cleared together"), and `packages/documentation/developers/rest-api.md` documents no duplicate endpoint either. CONTRIBUTING requires behavior/data-model decisions of this kind to land in the canonical subsystem doc rather than in a docblock.
searchedFor: grep -i duplicat in packages/sheets/src and packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet

samples.summary: Workbook-model rules for copying a worksheet (chart source repointing, pivot drop) placed in a backend-only helper rather than in `@wafflebase/sheets`, where the sibling cross-tab repointing helpers live
samples.evidence: `@wafflebase/sheets` owns the equivalent rules the backend is otherwise required to reuse: `worksheet-structure.ts:448-500` (`shift/moveChartRangesForSource`) and `:686-740` (cross-tab chart/pivot `sourceTabId` repointing), plus the tab-name helpers `tab-ops.ts` already imports. `docs/design/rest-api.md:265-270` states the API runs "the same engine helpers the editor does" so chart and pivot anchors follow an edit through one implementation. The new copy semantics are instead written inline in backend `tab-ops.ts`, so if the editor ever gains "Duplicate sheet" (the frontend has no such command today) it will need a second, forkable copy of these rules.

verdict.reason: The tab-id guard is genuinely absent from the sibling v1 worksheet controllers. `assertPlainTabId`/`UNSAFE_TAB_IDS` exist only in worksheet-images.controller.ts:51-55 (called at :82, :95); every enumerated sibling still does the bare `root.sheets?.[tabId]` truthiness check before writing: worksheet.controller.ts:46-50 (then ws.frozenRows at :85-87), worksheet-dimensions.controller.ts:53-60, worksheet-rules.controller.ts:55-59, worksheet-styles.controller.ts:50-54, worksheet-charts.controller.ts:45-49, worksheet-filter-pivot.controller.ts:43-47, cells.controller.ts:88/125/158/193/230, tabs.controller.ts:147/251 (and yorkie/tab-ops.ts:211-217). No global cover exists: main.ts installs only a ValidationPipe (bodies, not raw string params) and workspace-scope.guard.ts never inspects tabId. The one partial counterexample, worksheet-structure.controller.ts:104-113, guards by a different mechanism (safeWorksheetRecordKeys membership, packages/sheets/src/model/workbook/worksheet-record.ts:33) and is not among the flagged sites; it makes the headline "one controller only" imprecise but strengthens the duplication/wrong-layer substance — three different tab-lookup shapes now coexist on one route surface, and the structure controller's membership test additionally catches proxy-magic keys (toString/toJSON/getID) that the new UNSAFE_TAB_IDS set misses, so the sibling routes keep a gap reachable through a live Yorkie proxy, not merely in test fixtures. Real and blocking under the design-fit lens as a wrong-layer/duplicated-check mismatch with behavioral cost on unfixed routes.
